findings.claim: ReviveSeat is called without a Units reader, so a revived seat's brief says 'Units unavailable' and carries no 'Collect first:' line.
findings.evidence: cmd/metasystem/intent_machine.go:127 passes TickConfig{Now, Seat, ProviderHome} with no Units; seat_start.go:179 defaults Units to an error. The steward's own seat start (runner.go:406-411 -> StartSeat -> seatDependenciesForConfig) is wired by steward_seat.go:189.
findings.change: Optionally wire the steward's unit-stage reader into machine revive; later list.
findings.relation: pre-existing reader gap on the person's revive path, outside the changed lines

findings.claim: TestTheTickAsksForAPersonsRoundFromTheHostStore is not parallel, because t.Setenv forbids it.
findings.evidence: uncollected_round_test.go: the test opens with t.Setenv("METASYSTEM_SUPERVISION_REGISTRY_HOME", ...) and no t.Parallel(). The package already has non-parallel tests, and the redirect is what makes the host-store branch hermetic.

findings.claim: With Home defaulted to HomeStateRoot, tests that build seat readers through defaultSeatDependencies with an empty WorkStateRoot now read the real host unit store, read-only.
findings.evidence: seat_start.go:166 and :1175-1181. Fixture run ids miss in the host store and are skipped at :1185-1187; nothing is written.
findings.relation: test hermeticity: read-only host store reads
